terms.comment: Dad’s leather hip bag, the word of the libellī (the Libellus I gloss: pēra parva quae ad latus geritur); scorteus “of leather” (Varro, LL 7.84).
In the libellī a pēra is a backpack.

phrases.latin: Praetereā pater sacculum scorteum ad latus gerit, in quō tēlephōnum, crumēnam, pugillārēs, stilum, auscultābula semper servat.
phrases.english: Dad also wears a leather bag at his side, in which he always keeps his phone, wallet, notepad, pen and headphones.

sources: Lewis & Short: sacculus · Lewis & Short: scorteus
